steps.note: The original frozen legacy source is the only baseline. derive-legacy-boot3 is not an M1 step.
JDK-model extractor (javax.lang.model through JavacTask on the pinned toolchain JDK; unpinned or JDK mismatch refuses). Precedes scan-with-mta: the MTA handoff refuses without the inventory (AR-4.1).

Record what the SOURCE does, while the source is still the only thing that can say. scripts/capture-source-scenarios.py packages the frozen source, starts its isolated runtime, restores the initial state before each scenario that asks for it, replays the Operator-approved corpus (verification/scenarios/corpus.json) recording the state before and after each request, then captures the idempotent reads through that same runtime and stops what it started. No admission receipt is needed here: M1 precedes M2, so the capture binds to the evidence bundle. Idle when the corpus is absent, and it says so in its receipt (verification/source-oracles/scenarios/_capture.json): a missing corpus is a recorded gap, never an invented expectation and never silence. Nothing here reads the destination, and no worker ever sets an expected value.

Binds the platform-recorded pilot authorization to the bundle just produced and mints M2 (idempotent; mints nothing under a not-activated planner or an unfit bundle). The decision was the named human act of creating the workspace; this step only derives the binding, and admission still gates the plan.
